# ECN-2026-010 - Change notice - Hot Forge induction billet heater #3

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-IH03

Reason for change
- Operational failures and a recent root cause review identified insufficient coil cooling flow to EQ-P3-L1-IH03 as a primary contributor to premature coil degradation and intermittent heater trips.
- To align maintenance practice with equipment capability and prevent repeated downtime, the coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) is 65 L/min.
- This change consolidates corrective actions from ECN-2026-006 and updates procedural references in SOP-P3-L1-01 and SOP-P3-L1-02.

Affected items
- EQ-P3-L1-IH03 induction heater assembly, cooling loop, flow sensing, and alarm setpoints.
- Associated wiring and PLC tags tied to flow interlocks for the heater.
- Operator and maintenance procedures referencing allowable cooling flow thresholds in SOP-P3-L1-01 and SOP-P3-L1-02.

Implementation
- Update PLC interlock logic and alarm thresholds to reference the minimum value specified above. Validate logic in a controlled offline test prior to returning to production.
- Replace or recalibrate flow sensor and indicator for the EQ-P3-L1-IH03 cooling loop if current accuracy cannot be verified to support the specified minimum.
- Revise SOP-P3-L1-01 and SOP-P3-L1-02 to incorporate the new minimum flow requirement and add a verification step to be performed during pre-start checks.
- Perform commissioning run with process monitor active and record flow verification to archive with this ECN. Any deviations discovered during validation will be addressed under ECN-2026-006.

Approvals
- Engineering: [signature block] — approves technical changes to EQ-P3-L1-IH03 and PLC logic.
- Maintenance: [signature block] — approves sensor replacement/recalibration scope.
- Operations: [signature block] — acknowledges updated pre-start checks and SOP changes.

Related documents
- ECN-2026-006
- SOP-P3-L1-01
- SOP-P3-L1-02
